description: This Java class, ThingsPersistenceStreamingActorCreator, defines static methods for creating and starting ActorRef instances that handle streaming of persisted 'things' in an Akka-based system. It provides mechanisms to create actors for event streaming and snapshot streaming, utilizing actor properties and helper methods for ID conversions.

classes.name: ThingsPersistenceStreamingActorCreator
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods to create and start Akka actors responsible for streaming persisted 'things' data, including methods for event streaming and snapshot streaming.

methods.name: startEventStreamingActor
methods.description: Creates and starts an actor responsible for streaming event data related to persisted 'things', configured with a specified cache size and actor creation function.

methods.name: startSnapshotStreamingActor
methods.description: Creates and starts an actor responsible for streaming snapshot data of 'things', using a provided actor creation function.

methods.name: createElement
methods.description: Constructs a ThingTag object based on a PidWithSeqNr instance, linking a persistence ID and sequence number.

methods.name: createPidWithSeqNr
methods.description: Creates a PidWithSeqNr object from an EntityIdWithRevision, extracting entity ID and revision.

methods.name: pid2EntityId
methods.description: Converts a persistence ID string to a ThingId object by removing the prefix pattern.

methods.name: entityId2Pid
methods.description: Generates a persistence ID string from a given EntityId by prefixing it with a specific constant.
